knownDecisions: Omega is a workstream inside the canonical OG RAW Frontier monorepo, not a separate repository.
The Git repository is the source-code transfer mechanism; live database and object data remain a separate secured migration.
The local AI boundary is OpenAI-compatible and can use IBM Granite without replacing Omega orchestration, memory, or policy layers.
Mentor candidate review remains approval-first; the 13 curated winners are proposals pending explicit ingestion authorization.
Granite performs transcript analysis and classification; lawful acquisition, Whisper transcription, Supabase persistence, deduplication, and retrieval verification remain separate gates.
Historical private or failed source IDs are not retried automatically.
ChatGPTMentors Firebase phone verification and Supabase Third-Party Auth remain part of this monorepo; live Firebase/Supabase settings and identity records remain external.
The cloud-phone path stays disabled and spend-free in Git; launch and publish require separate owner approvals, and the initial runtime cap is five minutes per profile per day.
GeeLark API access is plan-dependent; the free-account fallback is a supervised desktop handoff rather than pretending API automation is available.
IBM Granite prepares and validates authorized content but never receives account passwords or two-factor codes and does not bypass provider or platform controls.
The Granite GitHub agent uses a GitHub App instead of one machine-wide gh login so each user authorizes selected repositories.
GitHub tokens, encryption keys, approval state, audit records, and repository clones remain outside Git and separated by durable user/workspace partitions.

Repository writes, branches, commits, pushes, and draft pull requests require encrypted one-time approvals; force-push, merge, reset, deletion, arbitrary shell, traversal, .git metadata, and symlink access are not exposed.
